conflicts.fact: Sequence of lessons and where the cylinder and frustum are covered; Lesson 1 and 3 refer to placeholders and lesson numbers that do not match
conflicts.versions: Lesson 1 Model Journal has placeholders 'Cylinder (Lesson 2)', 'Sphere/Hemisphere (Lesson 3)', 'Frustum (Lesson 5)', but Lesson 2 is pyramids, Lesson 4 is hemisphere, Lesson 5 is frustum introduction, and no lesson teaches cylinder surface area. Lesson 2 refers to comparison across 'cylinder, frustum, and pyramid'. Lesson 3 says it is 'Lesson 8 data' for the bucket dimensions.
